notes: Equipment starts with Rare Potential most of the time. A small chance starts at a higher rank (Potential page).
Each (Bonus) Potential has at most three random stat lines. The first line is usually a prime line; the second and third can be prime at a much lower chance.
Bonus Potential is a separate pool that stacks with regular Potential. It is available only on Regular and Interactive worlds (per page).
The Auto Enhancement System is not available in GMS (per page). Reset systems listed as KMS-only are not in GMS.
Retired Potential Stamps are not included.
max_stat_percent_meaning: Largest percentage bonus a single line can roll for that rank and equipment level (page table "Maximum Stat% Based on Equipment Level").

rank_up_guaranteed_reset_counts.note: Resets needed for a guaranteed rank up, from the page table. KMS and MSEA only; not GMS.
